headline: How to Get Ignitis
title: How to Get Ignitis in Aniimo | Evolve Wisptis at Level 29 | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want Ignitis in Aniimo? It evolves from Wisptis, and the rules are simple. Raise your Wisptis to level twenty nine. Then defeat three Wisptis of the same form as yours, one after another. Spend a Night Stone and the evolution is yours. You can also hunt wild Ignitis in Berylline Vale. Plan the three fights first so the streak is not broken. Which Ignitis form will you chase? Comment below!
description: Ignitis in Aniimo evolves from Wisptis at level 29 after defeating three Wisptis of the same form in succession, using a Night Stone.
